notes: Programme page is a Parcoursup fiche for the Double licence Economie et gestion / Géographie et aménagement at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord. The statement about applying on Parcoursup on this page applies to French or European baccalaureate holders; a Moroccan applicant with a foreign diploma must apply via Etudes en France / Campus France (see https://www.maroc.campusfrance.org/candidature-en-1ere-annee-de-licence-a-l-universite-et-en-paces), so applicationChannel and any Parcoursup calendar dates are not captured here. Tuition of 178 EUR/year is the headline amount on this fiche; Campus France states differentiated tuition fees that may apply to non-EU students (2 902 EUR for a Licence year) unless exemption. The private-school fee range (6 000 to 18 000 EUR/year) is a general figure, not this programme's fee.
